mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_RECOMMEND (PRODUCT_ID, RECOMMENDED_PRODUCT_ID, RANK_ORDER, BASIS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{recommendedProductId}, #{rankOrder}, #{basis}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT pr.RECOMMENDED_PRODUCT_ID AS `productId`, pr.RECOMMENDED_PRODUCT_ID AS `recommendedProductId`, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS `productName`, p.PRICE AS `price`, p.PRODUCT_TYPE AS `productType`, p.CATEGORY_ID AS `categoryId`, b.BRAND_NAME AS `brandName`, img.IMG_URL AS `imgUrl`, IFNULL(r.avgRating, 0) AS `rating`, IFNULL(r.reviewCount, 0) AS `rCount`, IFNULL(o.orderCount, 0) AS `orderCount` FROM PRODUCT_RECOMMEND pr JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = pr.RECOMMENDED_PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON b.BRAND_ID = p.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG WHERE IS_MAIN = 'Y' ) img ON img.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, AVG(RATING) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM REVIEW GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ) r ON r.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS orderCount FROM ORDER_ITEM GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ) o ON o.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE pr.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY pr.RANK_ORDER ASC
